program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A solid separator divides two same-sized panels; their overlap is the output.
    if len(set(grid[0])) == 1 and all(all(v == grid[0][0] for v in row) for row in grid):
        pass
    row_sep = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    col_sep = next((c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid)), None)
    if row_sep is not None and row_sep > 0 and h-row_sep-1 == row_sep:
        a, b = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep+1:]
        return [[2 if a[r][c] != 0 and b[r][c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(row_sep)]
    if col_sep is not None and col_sep > 0 and w-col_sep-1 == col_sep:
        return [[2 if row[c] != 0 and row[col_sep+1+c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(col_sep)] for row in grid]

'''
